name: GRouNdGAN reference AnnData
description: AnnData file used by GRouNdGAN as the reference expression dataset and public gene-order source. For pretrained checkpoint execution, var_names must match the gene order used by the checkpoint and causal graph.
validation_notes: The file must be readable by scanpy.read_h5ad.
Rows are cells and columns are genes in AnnData convention; wrapper normalization transposes generated data into ANDREA expression.tsv with genes as rows.
var_names define the public gene IDs used to map numeric GRouNdGAN causal graph indices to truth/networks.csv rows.
For perturbation runs, obs.cluster should be present when the upstream perturbation plotting route is used, because GRouNdGAN's SCDataset loader expects a cluster column.
The gene order must be identical to the order used when training the supplied GRouNdGAN checkpoints.
